mostWorthwhile.text: Making the Moon was most worthwhile: the pale stone reflecting sunlight gave the gentler-light goal a clear, useful explanation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making day and night was clear but felt like a detour from the gentler-light goal I was pursuing.

surprise.text: The storm gathered unlit stones into a rocky world rather than the galaxy I expected; their collisions also made the new world hot.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely purposeless, although using wind to scatter burning stones into a starfield followed the game's myth rather than a realistic account of star formation.

continue.text: Yes. The reflected-light and day-and-night explanations made the combinations enjoyable, and I would be curious to see how the rocky world develops.
